meta.name: twitter-automation
meta.description: Automate Twitter/X with posting, engagement, and user management via inference.sh CLI. Apps: x/post-tweet, x/post-create (with media), x/post-like, x/post-retweet, x/dm-send, x/user-follow. Capabilities: post tweets, schedule content, like posts, retweet, send DMs, follow users, get profiles. Use for: social media automation, content scheduling, engagement bots, audience growth, X API. Triggers: twitter api, x api, tweet automation, post to twitter, twitter bot, social media automation, x automation, tweet scheduler, twitter integration, post tweet, twitter post, x post, send tweet

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 批量发推、点赞、转发、私信和关注,把社媒互动交给脚本自动跑
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果每天手动发推、互动、私信太耗时,想批量自动完成
copy.tagline_en: Automate posting, liking, retweeting, DMs, and follows on Twitter/X in bulk
copy.fit_line_en: For you if manually posting, engaging, and DMing on X eats your day

howto.what: Claude 会通过 belt 命令行调用 inference.sh 的 X 应用,替你在 Twitter/X 上发推文(含带图片或视频的帖子)、点赞、转推、发私信、关注用户,也能查用户资料或推文详情、删推文。
howto.when: 当你提到「twitter api」「tweet automation」「post to twitter」等关键词,或要求发推文、安排内容发布、做互动时触发。

say.text: 帮我发一条推文:Hello from inference.sh!
say.note: 调用 x/post-tweet 发布文字推文

say.text: 给 ID 为 1234567890 的推文点赞
say.note: 调用 x/post-like 点赞该推文
调用 x/user-follow 关注该账号

howto.what_en: Claude drives the inference.sh belt CLI to act on Twitter/X: post text tweets or posts with media, like, retweet, send DMs, follow users, and also fetch user profiles or tweet details and delete tweets.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention Twitter API, tweet automation, post to twitter and similar keywords, or ask to post a tweet, schedule content, or run engagement tasks.

say_en.text: Post a tweet for me: Hello from inference.sh!
say_en.note: Runs x/post-tweet to publish the text tweet
